# בית עולמים — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> A Chevra Kadisha (Jewish burial society) organization providing traditional Jewish funeral and burial services. The website needs to present their services in a dignified and respectful manner, with a dynamic service list that can be easily managed — allowing administrators to add or remove services over time without technical assistance.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About בית עולמים
A Chevra Kadisha (Jewish burial society) organization providing traditional Jewish funeral and burial services. The website needs to present their services in a dignified and respectful manner, with a dynamic service list that can be easily managed — allowing administrators to add or remove services over time without technical assistance.

## Target Audience
- משפחות שכולות וקהל הזקוק לשירותי קבורה
- משפחות שכולות
- מתכנני קהילה מבוגרים
- ארגונים דתיים

## Industry
שירותי קבורה ולוויה
